full_name: Susan Meiselas | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow/David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Artist
bio: Susan Meiselas has worked as a freelance photographer since 1976. She is best known for her coverage of the insurrection in Nicaragua and her documentation of human rights issues in Latin America.
